algorithm_plan.description: Validate vector_x, vector_y, and p_parameter inputs against declared contract: equal length required, p >= 1.0, both vectors non-empty, all elements must be finite float64. No Lp norm computation performed at this step.

Define element-wise difference topology: for each index i, compute x_i - y_i in left-to-right order (index 0 to n-1). Traversal order is canonical and must be fixed before implementation. No kernel executed at this step.

Define absolute value topology: apply |x_i - y_i| to each element-wise difference in the same left-to-right order. For p=inf, the maximum of absolute values is the final result and the power and summation steps are bypassed. No kernel executed.

Define power topology: for finite p >= 1, compute |x_i - y_i|^p for each element using float64 power operation. Overflow must route to NOT_COMPUTABLE. For p=inf this step is skipped. No kernel executed.
Define summation topology: accumulate sum_i |x_i - y_i|^p in canonical left-to-right order using float64 accumulation. For p=inf this step is replaced by max aggregation. No kernel executed.

Define root extraction topology: compute (sum_i |x_i - y_i|^p)^(1/p) via float64 power operation. For p=1 no root is required (sum is the result). For p=2 use float64 square root. For p=inf the max from step-005 is the result. No kernel executed.

Define not-computable detection branches: empty vector (n=0), p < 1.0, mismatched vector lengths, non-finite element values (NaN or infinite), and power overflow must all route to a documented NOT_COMPUTABLE state without emitting a distance value.

Define baseline comparator topology: compare future computed Lp distance against expected_lp_distance fields in valid fixture records. Tolerance policy declared but not applied. No computation or comparison executed at this step.

numerical_stability_plan.description: Float64 required for all element-wise differences, power operations, summation accumulation, and root extraction. Float32 excluded per readiness dossier numerical constraints.
numerical_stability_plan.planned_guardrail: Require float64 precision declaration; reject float32 inputs at validation boundary.

numerical_stability_plan.description: Empty vector inputs (n=0) must be detected at the input validation step and produce a documented NOT_COMPUTABLE path without any element-wise operation.
numerical_stability_plan.planned_guardrail: Route to not-computable state; no distance scalar emitted.

numerical_stability_plan.description: p < 1.0 is not a valid norm parameter and must be rejected at input validation. The p=inf sentinel convention must be declared and fixed before implementation to ensure deterministic branch selection.
numerical_stability_plan.planned_guardrail: p < 1.0 routes to NOT_COMPUTABLE; p=inf sentinel declared explicitly in data layout before implementation.

numerical_stability_plan.description: Non-finite float64 values (NaN or infinite) in either input vector must be detected before any element-wise operation and produce NOT_COMPUTABLE without propagating NaN through the power or summation steps.
numerical_stability_plan.planned_guardrail: Scan for non-finite values at input validation; route to not-computable state before any element-wise computation.

numerical_stability_plan.description: For large p values or large element magnitudes, |x_i - y_i|^p may overflow float64. Acceptable input magnitude bound and maximum p value must be declared before implementation; overflow must route to NOT_COMPUTABLE.
numerical_stability_plan.planned_guardrail: Declare maximum allowed element magnitude and maximum p value in the implementation plan; add NOT_COMPUTABLE branch for detected overflow.

numerical_stability_plan.description: Define all conditions under which NOT_COMPUTABLE is the correct output: empty vector, p < 1, mismatched lengths, non-finite element, power overflow. Ensure no silent fallback to a numeric distance value.
numerical_stability_plan.planned_guardrail: Enumerate all NOT_COMPUTABLE branches in algorithm topology before implementation; validate each branch has a dedicated test fixture planned.
